lines.reference: SA cake wheat flour label (Golden Cloud, via FatSecret ZA): 1499 kJ, 8.2 g protein, 0.9 g fat, 76 g glycaemic carbohydrate / 100 g (used 358 kcal / 100 g)
Leavening agents, yeast, baker's, active dry — USDA FDC 175043: 325 kcal / 100 g
Sugars, granulated — USDA FDC 169655: 387 kcal / 100 g
Oil, sunflower, linoleic (less than 60%) — USDA FDC 171017: 884 kcal / 100 g
Butter, salted — USDA FDC 173410: 717 kcal / 100 g
Jams and preserves, apricot — USDA FDC 170645: 242 kcal / 100 g
Cheese, cheddar — USDA FDC 173414: 403 kcal / 100 g

notes: Assumptions that change the number: shaping flour and bowl oil not counted; each split roll is filled with 1/8 of the butter (10 g), jam (~21 g) and cheddar (~19 g). Sanity check: plain roosterkoek is 225 kcal (SPAR) and 254 kcal (Pick n Pay) per 90 g roll, FatSecret ZA. Our plain roll is ~260 kcal (~95 g baked), and the filling adds ~200, giving 460.
